propositions: The reconciler lacks a configuration-driven mechanism to select which backend implementation (Jira, or future alternatives) to instantiate at runtime.
The backend selection must be config-driven via a new `reconciler.backend` field on `ReconcilerConfig`, validated at config-load time by a constrained `_as_choice` coercer.
A new in-tree decorator-registry in `_backend_registry.py` must provide `register(key, factory)` and `select_backend(config)` to resolve the configured backend key to a `Backend` instance.
JiraBackend must be registered under the key 'jira' via `@register('jira', ...)` decorator without rewiring any existing consumer (defer rewiring of _load_acli / AcliClient sites to story S4).
The registry must be populated lazily by `select_backend()` importing `adapters` module, which in turn imports each adapter's backend to trigger registration side-effects.
Test infrastructure must provide `_reset_registry_for_test()` context manager to isolate backend registry state across tests and enable registration of test doubles like FakeBackend.
